accounting_rules: Application configurations are recipes, not extra machines.
A fixed/mobile package and its four component prices are alternative quote scopes, never additive charges.
Unknown prices and capacities remain null, not zero.
No module destroys elements; contaminants must be removed, transferred, immobilized or retained.
All reuse and claimed benefits require separate permits, assays, contracts and counterfactuals.
